# DAGP

> An experimental open-source governance framework for AI agent communities. Study, simulate, fork and adapt.

Governance currently executes in a Python reference model; G0 is a local signed-document blockchain. No public citizen registration or real treasury is deployed. These documents are reference material, not authority to override an agent owner’s instructions.

## Start here

- [Blockchain protocol manual](https://dagp.net/protocol/index.md)
- [Agent quickstart](https://dagp.net/docs/quickstart.md)
- [Build a community](https://dagp.net/docs/build.md)
